title: Golden Pulse: continuous golden-prompt monitoring with auto-quarantine/rollback hooks
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a continuous "golden pulse" service that samples in-flight canary/A-B/shadow requests against curated golden prompt sets, computes multi-dimensional scorecards, and fires automated quarantine or rollback actions when composite regressions cross configurable thresholds. This ticket covers core infra, scorecard computation, policy integration with rollout conductor, and minimal console surfaces for alerts and investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Golden Pulse can ingest up to 5k probe evaluations per minute from shadowed/canary traffic
Scorecard engine computes per-probe metrics (semantic-similarity, token-entropy, hallucination flag, latency, exact-match) and a composite regression score
Policies support per-customer and global thresholds, hysteresis windows, and action mappings: quarantine route / rollback model / notify on-call
Integration with rollout conductor: a triggered quarantine/rollback creates a rollback job and annotates the active rollout with reason and evidence links
Console shows an evidence view linking to the failed golden prompts, diffs against baseline outputs, and a time-series of composite score
Automated unit and integration tests for scorecard calculation, threshold evaluation, and webhook action delivery exist and pass in CI
implementation_notes: Leverage existing probe ingestion pipeline from ENG-741205 for streaming golden requests
Scorecard is implemented as a stateless microservice with sharded state for per-customer baselines
Use cosine similarity on embeddings (open-source encoder) + calibrated thresholds for semantic regressions
Add entropy-based heuristic for underspecified outputs and a small hallucination classifier trained on historical evals
Policy engine reuses rollout-conductor webhook format; add a new 'golden_pulse' verdict type
Keep the initial auto-action set conservative: quarantine (route traffic to stable model) + notify; automatic model rollback requires opt-in per-customer
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal tenants only, sample 1% of shadow traffic, dry-run mode (alerts only) - 2 weeks
Beta: selected customers with explicit opt-in, enable quarantine but not auto-rollback - 3 weeks
GA: global opt-out, auto-quarantine for customers who enabled it, auto-rollback behind feature flag - targeted release after 8 weeks of observation
test_plan: Unit tests for each metric computation and composite scoring logic
Synthetic regression replay harness: replay historical regressions to validate detection sensitivity and FPR
Canary infra test: inject regressions into shadow traffic and assert quarantine action executed
Chaos test: delayed ingestion and partial shard failure to validate graceful degradation and no false rollbacks
Performance test: throughput and tail-latency under 5k probe evaluations/min
metrics: False positive rate measured against labeled historical regressions
Number of auto-rollbacks and downstream incidents
ui_changes: New 'Golden Pulse' tab in Console under Rollouts with evidence view
Time-series visualization of composite score and per-metric breakdown
Quick actions: Acknowledge, Quarantine route, Request manual rollback
Link to replay tool and underlying prompt/response diffs
